random.description: This is a gross pathology specimen of the larynx or trachea showing a prominent exophytic, polypoid, papillary tumor projecting into the lumen. The whitish, cauliflower-like mass is friable and partially ulcerated with foci of hemorrhage. These morphologic features are characteristic of a squamous papilloma (or laryngeal papillomatosis) of the respiratory tract.
